svg.title: Сгибание ног лёжа с гантелью — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Prone dumbbell leg curl on a flat horizontal bench, side three-quarter view. Athlete lies face down, chest, pelvis and both thighs supported by bench; knees at its foot end. Exactly ONE small recognizable dumbbell with a handle and two end weights is securely gripped BETWEEN BOTH FEET, held by foot pressure, never in hands. Left: legs nearly straight and parallel to floor extending beyond bench, dumbbell held off floor. Right: both KNEES flex roughly ninety degrees to raise lower legs and dumbbell above bench; thighs, torso, hips remain fully supported and still, feet keep the same dumbbell clamped. Show the foot-to-dumbbell connection clearly in both frames. No lever or machine. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
